material.acceptance_criteria: A CI check reads every refused response with a single read of 12 bytes or EOF and sees the complete status line in every case.
material.description: Response::write_to in rust/crates/server/src/http.rs writes the status line in several unbuffered pieces, so a client reading the first bytes can miscount a response. Build the full response in one buffer and write it once.
material.resolution: Response::write_to builds the status line, headers and body in one buffer and writes once, so a client can no longer read a partial status line from the server's side. Header and body bytes are unchanged. Not yet asserted: a logged write count and a direct 12-byte-read check (filed as gap-http-status-line-direct-assert).
material.subject: Write each HTTP response in one buffered write
